About CMA

Premier Muay Thai Training in San Francisco

California Martial Athletics has been raising the bar for martial arts and fitness since 2019.

View Schedule

Facility

Biggest Muay Thai Gym in San Francisco

  • Two-Level Facility: 4,500+ sq ft across two levels for Muay Thai classes, bag work, strength, and conditioning.
  • Full boxing ring plus 9 heavy bags.
  • Strength and conditioning area with weights, cardio equipment, and assault bikes.
  • Beginner-Friendly Environment: Classes for every level.
  • 30+ Weekly Classes: Offered mornings, midday, and evenings.
  • Elite Coaches: 25+ years guiding casual members to competitive fighters.

Amenities

A complete training experience.

  • Women's and men's locker rooms with showers and an all-gender restroom.
  • Secure storage for your gear and personal items.
  • Open mat space for stretching, warm-ups, and extra training.

Transportation & Parking

Polk Street, between Bush and Sutter.

  • Street parking, parking garages, and multiple public transit stops are nearby.
  • Polk-Bush Garage: 1399 Bush St.
  • Civic Center Bart Station.
  • Muni: 19, 49, 14.
